dimensions.missing_detail: no corrected numerical evidence is registered for this claim

dimensions.missing_detail: no direct continuation/topology evidence is registered for this claim

dimensions.missing_detail: no independent physical formulation is registered for this claim

dimensions.description: A machine-derived conditioning or margin audit passes.
dimensions.missing_detail: no conditioning-margin verdict artifact is registered

dimensions.description: Truth-known calibration demonstrates detection power at the required scale.

dimensions.description: A bound mutation/metamorphic audit passes for the truth machinery.

dimensions.description: A blind or implementation-independent version supports the claim.
dimensions.missing_detail: no blind N-version evidence is registered for this claim

dimensions.description: A cross-platform systematics artifact reports agreement inside the frozen envelope.
dimensions.missing_detail: no platform-systematics verdict artifact is registered

dimensions.description: The novelty search is current and passed without claiming a novelty theorem.
A rigorous theorem/proof certificate artifact passes.
dimensions.missing_detail: no theorem-grade certificate verdict artifact is registered

dimensions.description: The discovery manifest contains no unresolved scientific blockers.

numerical_paper.description: Every non-theorem assurance dimension required for a numerical paper must pass.

theorem_grade.description: Theorem readiness is separate and additionally requires a rigorous certificate.

rules: No status may be averaged into a scalar score.
Every pass is re-derived from a manifest rule, evidence identity, or bound artifact verdict.
Missing, infrastructure-blocked, failed, and scientifically unresolved are distinct states.
The numerical-paper and theorem-grade profiles are separate conjunctions.
